product_family: Market intelligence and AI-powered research platform for financial services. Sub-products: AlphaSense Platform (financial document search), Tegus Expert Insights (expert call transcripts and broker research), Enterprise Intelligence (private cloud deployment), Generative Search / Deep Research (AI-synthesized research reports).

privacy.ai_training_note: Explicitly stated: 'LLM models are never trained on customer uploaded data.' Zero data retention contracts enforced with all LLM partners (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini) accessed via AWS Bedrock private links. Queries are aggregated and anonymized; prompts are never stored in LLMs. Account-level opt-out available for organisations with governance requirements. Note: the privacy policy's AI training restriction is stated narrowly for Google Workspace APIs specifically ('No Google Workspace APIs are used to develop, improve, or train generalized AI and/or ML models on any customer data or inputs'), while the security page and GenAI security page make the broader claim. The broader claim is backed by dedicated GenAI security documentation.
privacy.data_region: US default: AWS us-east-1 (Northern Virginia) and us-west-1 (Northern California). EU option: AWS eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) available for Enterprise Intelligence customers requiring GDPR data sovereignty.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS 1.2 or higher; HTTPS for all end-user communication; mTLS for Enterprise Intelligence internal connections.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256. Customer content stored in dedicated, encrypted S3 buckets with no data co-mingling.

security.name: Key management
security.value: Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) and Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) available. Bring Your Own Bucket (BYOB) supported for full encryption key control.

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: Amazon Web Services (AWS). Private cloud deployment on AWS or GCP available for Enterprise Intelligence. Virtual Private Clouds with internet access disabled; single HTTPS ingress only.

security.name: Monitoring
security.value: 24/7 system monitoring with anomaly detection logging. Third-party penetration testing performed regularly.

security.name: Authentication
security.value: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) enforced. SAML 2.0 SSO support. Identity Access Management (IAM) tooling.

security.name: Tenant isolation
security.value: Logical separation during processing and indexing prevents cross-customer data access. Dedicated encrypted storage per customer.

security.name: Backup
security.value: Daily encrypted backups with restricted access for data restoration.

security.name: External security ratings
security.value: SecurityScorecard: A grade. CryptCheck: A+ rating. Qualys SSL Labs: A+ rating.

security.name: Vulnerability disclosure
security.value: Public Vulnerability Disclosure Policy available at alpha-sense.com/legal-and-compliance/.

products.name: AlphaSense Platform
products.data_scope: 500M+ premium financial and business documents including company filings, broker research, Tegus expert transcripts, private and public financial data. Users may upload internal documents.
products.notes: Cloud-hosted on AWS. Data not used to train LLMs. SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 apply. Data residency: US default.

products.name: Enterprise Intelligence (Private Cloud)
products.data_scope: Customer's internal content (documents, data) processed within the customer's own cloud environment (AWS or GCP). Internal content never leaves the customer network.
products.notes: Deployable within customer cloud infrastructure. EU data residency available (Frankfurt). BYOK, BYOB, FIPS 140-2, SAML 2.0, and complete network isolation. Highest data sovereignty option.

products.name: Tegus Expert Insights
products.data_scope: Expert interview transcripts and broker research sourced from Tegus network. No customer PII in content corpus.
products.notes: Content licensed from Tegus (acquired by AlphaSense). Access controlled by entitlements.

products.name: Generative Search / Deep Research
products.data_scope: Runs on AlphaSense curated content and customer-uploaded internal content. Uses LLMs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini) via AWS Bedrock private endpoints.
products.notes: Zero data retention with all LLM partners. No customer data used for LLM training. Outputs include sentence-level citations. Account-level AI opt-out available.

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise subscription (annual). Free trial available via 'Get Started for Free'.
compare.data_residency: US (default: AWS us-east-1 / us-west-1) or EU (AWS eu-central-1, Frankfurt) for Enterprise Intelligence customers.

flags: AlphaSense states it is seeking ISO/IEC 42001 AI management certification. If marketing materials imply it is already held, that would be an over-claim.

A help center article states 'Audit Logs support compliance with SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA,' but no HIPAA BAA is documented in the public DPA or security pages. This informal mention could mislead healthcare buyers who require a formal BAA.

The privacy policy's AI training restriction is narrowly worded for 'Google Workspace APIs' only, while the security and GenAI security pages make a broader claim. The dedicated GenAI security page backs the broader claim with contractual and technical controls, though the narrower privacy-policy language creates a minor inconsistency.

Trust center requires NDA for full reports: 'Reports and certifications are available through the AlphaSense Trust Center, subject to NDA where applicable.' SOC 2 Type 2 report is not publicly downloadable.
